zones.label: Intro
zones.text:
When a Nasdaq-listed HealthTech company acquired a leading cloud EHR platform serving 17 million patients and processing $3 billion in medical claims annually — the integration clock started immediately.
The engineering challenge was real: multiple teams, multiple technical disciplines, a hard board deadline, and a platform where every bug has real consequences for real patients.
Standard US hiring timelines would have missed the deadline by months. GoGloby placed 25 senior engineers across DevOps, Python/Data, Fullstack, and iOS in 58 days. 12 months later, 96% of the team was still in place — now building the AI-powered features that define the platform’s next chapter.

zones.label: The Challenge
zones.text:
The Challenge
A board deadline that US hiring cannot meet .
This Nasdaq-listed HealthTech company’s acquisition of a leading EHR platform created an engineering integration challenge that most Nasdaq-listed companies face and most underestimate. The two platforms had to work together. New features had to ship. Existing systems — serving 17 million patients and processing $3 billion in annual medical claims — could not degrade during the transition. And the engineering team needed to grow by 25 people, across multiple disciplines, faster than US hiring has ever been designed to move.
The math was unworkable in the US market. 25 senior engineers at US rates — $160K to $200K per role across DevOps, Python/Data, Fullstack, and iOS — would have cost the company over $4M annually. The standard recruiting timeline for 25 roles, even with aggressive agency support, runs 4 to 8 months. The board had set a different timeline: 58 days.
The compliance constraint was non-negotiable. Every engineer who would access the client’s EHR systems was touching Protected Health Information under HIPAA. GoGloby’s answer was a model built specifically for this situation: four parallel sourcing squads, one per discipline, each with a dedicated sourcer, recruiter, and senior domain expert — running simultaneously from day one. The partnership began in March 2025 and remains active today.

zones.label: The GoGloby Model
zones.text:
The GoGloby Model
Before any sourcing began, GoGloby conducted 6 deep-dive calibration sessions across the client’s four hiring managers. Each session produced a precise brief: technical stack requirements, HIPAA context depth expected, cultural fit markers, AI tooling proficiency baseline, and communication standards for engineers working directly with US senior leadership. These sessions are what compressed GoGloby’s internal pass rate to 3.2% — the filter was precise before a single candidate was screened.
Squad / Track
Technical Scope & Compliance Requirements
DevOps / Infrastructure
AWS monitoring consolidation across the EHR platform—migrating fragmented third-party tools to native AWS solutions and building self-service implementation patterns. Focus on security: VPN, firewall hardening, audit logging, and intrusion detection.
Python / Data Engineering
ETL pipelines and data infrastructure for healthcare data migration and analytics using Python, dbt Core, AWS Redshift/Snowflake, Kafka, and Spark. AI/ML solution development managed under HIPAA minimum-necessary data access protocols.
Fullstack Engineering
HIPAA-compliant high-traffic application development using TypeScript, React, Django, GraphQL, and Redux/Apollo Client. Includes EHR feature development, WCAG-compliant UI, New Relic for APM, and Sentry for error monitoring.
iOS Mobile Engineering
Native iOS development for the EHR mobile platform using Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and Objective-C. Supports physicians accessing patient records, clinical workflows, telehealth, and billing features on mobile devices.

zones.label: The Compliance Infrastructure
zones.text:
The Compliance Infrastructure
Working with a Nasdaq-listed healthcare company operating under HIPAA is not the same as working with a standard SaaS company. The Master Services Agreement with GoGloby included provisions that most staffing partners cannot meet — and that GoGloby built its engagement model to satisfy in full.
Business Associate Agreement (BAA) : Every GoGloby-placed engineer covered under a signed BAA, establishing GoGloby as a HIPAA Business Associate with full PHI protection obligations, 24-hour breach reporting, and HHS audit rights.
Pre-Onboarding HIPAA certification : All 25 engineers completed HIPAA Security Rule training and received certification before first system access. GoGloby holds documented evidence per BAA requirements.
Background checks in 6 countries : Education, employment, address, 7-year criminal history, and OFAC screening across Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Portugal, and Ukraine.
Secure access infrastructure : VPN with 2FA, island.io secure browser for Virtual Environment, company-issued hardware only, firewall-enabled workstations with automatic patch updates.
PHI access restrictions : No PHI stored or transmitted outside US jurisdictions. Minimum-necessary access enforced. All Sensitive Personal Data encrypted in transit and at rest per HHS specifications.
Cyber liability coverage : $5M cyber liability insurance (first and third party), $3M professional liability, $5M general liability — contractual financial protection against any security incident.
This compliance infrastructure is the reason the client’s engineering leadership could grant GoGloby engineers access to a platform handling 17 million patient records on day 58 rather than month 6.

zones.label: The Team the Client Now Has
zones.text:
The Team the Client Now Has
When the engagement began, the requirement was for senior engineers who could execute on a post-acquisition integration timeline. Over the course of the engagement, the entire GoGloby-placed team transitioned to applied AI engineering as standard operating practice. Every engineer now uses Cursor and GitHub Copilot as primary development tools — not as experiments, but as the default workflow for the client’s platform.
Product Area
What the Client Is Shipping — GoGloby Engineer Contribution
AI ambient documentation (launched March 2026)
AI listens to provider-patient conversations and auto-generates HIPAA-compliant visit notes. Eliminates 8 minutes of documentation per visit. Increases same-day claim submissions by 32%. GoGloby’s Python, Fullstack, and Data engineers support the underlying EHR data infrastructure.
No show predictor
AI-powered appointment risk scoring — assigns no-show probability to upcoming appointments, enabling proactive outreach. Reduces empty slots, improves care continuity. GoGloby’s data engineers contribute to the ML pipeline.
Revenue cycle and billing AI
AI-powered claim rejection simplification, EDI Preview, Billing Summary reporting, Insurance Waterfall analytics, and Underpaid Items detection. GoGloby’s Fullstack and Python engineers work across the $3B billing platform.
AWS infrastructure
Monitoring consolidation from fragmented third-party tools to native AWS — self-service patterns for development teams. API migration (drchrono.com sunset, December 2025) and USCDI v3 / ONC HTI-1 compliance updates.
iOS EHR Mobile Platform
Native iOS app serving physicians across primary care, specialties, and urgent care — clinical form management, advanced text editor, real-time patient record access, appointment management.

zones.label: Why This Case Study Matters
zones.text:
Why This Case Study Matters
By integrating deep HIPAA compliance and an AI-native engineering workforce, the partnership provided the speed, security, and efficiency required for a high-stakes post-acquisition integration.
Post-Acquisition Engineering Scale-Up Has a Hard Timeline That Standard US Hiring Cannot Meet
The client’s board deadline was not negotiable. Standard US hiring — 60 to 90 days per senior role, at $160K to $200K per engineer — would have cost the integration timeline and likely the board’s confidence. GoGloby’s parallel squad model exists specifically for situations where sequential hiring is not an option.
HIPAA Compliance Is a Gate
Most staffing partners cannot operate under a Nasdaq-listed healthcare company’s MSA. GoGloby can — because the compliance infrastructure (BAA, background checks, HIPAA certification, VPN/2FA/island.io, $5M cyber liability coverage) is built into the engagement model before the first candidate is screened.
55.6% Client Interview Conversion Means the Hiring Manager’s Time Is Spent Deciding
SVPs of Engineering at companies of this scale have only a few hours per week for interviews. At 55.6% conversion, every interview the client conducted produced more than one hire on average — protecting the bandwidth of an SVP managing 100+ engineers, 3–5 active projects, and board-level delivery pressure.
Applied AI Engineering Is Now Table Stakes
The team GoGloby built is already operating with Cursor and GitHub Copilot as standard tooling — building the features (AI ambient documentation, No Show Predictor, claim automation) that define the client’s AI roadmap. Hiring engineers who arrive AI-capable is how 25 people can do the work that previously required many more.
